title: Kenyan Beef Pilau
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot and fry onions until golden brown.
Add garlic, cinnamon stick, cardamom pods, and pilau masala. Stir for 1 minute.
Add beef cubes and brown on all sides.
Pour in beef broth and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until beef is tender.
Add rice, stir gently, cover and cook on low heat until rice is fully cooked and liquid is absorbed.
Fluff with a fork and serve hot with kachumbari (fresh tomato and onion salad).
notes: For best results, use high-quality pilau masala. You can also add potatoes for a heartier meal.
